label: Video From References
description: Make a video from a prompt and material you give it, using the video models ElevenLabs serves (Google Veo 3.1, ByteDance Seedance). Give it images of what should appear in the video; on Veo, also images whose visual style to copy; on Seedance, clips to borrow motion from and sounds to use. For a video that opens or ends on a given image, use Generate Video: no model takes frames and references together. If you set something the model does not take, the call is refused before anything is charged. Needs your own ElevenLabs account on a Pro plan or above.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account: wire an ElevenLabsAccess node whose connection has "Images and video" ticked. weft's built-in connection cannot make images or videos, and each one is paid from this account's credits.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: What happens in the video, and how the material you give it appears in it.
inputs.placeholder: The mug from the photo turns slowly on a wooden table, soft morning light

inputs.name: subjects
inputs.description: Images of what appears in the video, like a person or a product. Up to 3 on Veo, counting `styles`. Up to 9 on Seedance 2.0, and no more than 12 files once clips and sounds are counted too. Up to 30 on Seedance 2.5.

inputs.name: styles
inputs.description: Veo only: images whose visual style the video copies. Up to 3 images in all, counting `subjects`.

inputs.name: videos
inputs.description: Seedance only: clips to take motion or subjects from. Seedance 2.0 takes up to 3, at most 15 seconds together; Seedance 2.5 up to 10, at most 30 seconds together.

inputs.name: audios
inputs.description: Seedance only: audio to use, such as speech a subject lip-syncs to. Seedance 2.0 takes up to 3, at most 15 seconds together, and needs a subject or a clip with them; Seedance 2.5 takes up to 10, at most 30 seconds together, and can use them alone.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: veo-3.1-fast-generate-001 (Veo 3.1 Fast) is the quick one, for previews and iteration; veo-3.1-generate-001 is the high-quality one. Seedance 2.5 takes the most material and makes the longest videos, up to 30 seconds; the fast and mini Seedance 2.0 models stop at 720p. The Seedance (ByteDance) models are refused with `model_access_denied` until ElevenLabs approves your workspace (ask ElevenLabs support for access), and are not offered in the United States.

inputs.name: durationSecs
inputs.label: Duration (seconds)
inputs.description: On Veo, leave it empty or set 8: it makes only 8-second videos from references. On Seedance, leave it empty for 5; Seedance 2.0 takes 4 to 15, Seedance 2.5 4 to 30.

inputs.name: aspectRatio
inputs.label: Aspect ratio
inputs.description: Leave empty for 16:9. Veo takes only 16:9 and 9:16. `auto` (Seedance only) lets the model match the material you give it.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.description: Leave empty for 720p. Veo takes 720p, 1080p and 4K; Seedance 2.0 takes 480p, 720p, 1080p and 4K, but its fast and mini models only 480p and 720p; Seedance 2.5 takes 480p, 720p and 1080p. 4K and 4k both work.

inputs.name: generateAudio
inputs.label: Sound
inputs.description: The model makes a soundtrack along with the picture. If you want a silent video, untick it.

inputs.name: negativePrompt
inputs.label: Negative prompt
inputs.description: Veo only: what the video should avoid.

inputs.name: promptAsWritten
inputs.label: Use prompt as written
inputs.description: Veo only. Veo may rewrite your prompt to improve it; if you want it used exactly as you wrote it, tick this.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Veo and Seedance 2.0 only. If you want to be able to make a similar video again, set any whole number here, then run again with that number and the same inputs. Leave empty for a new random seed each run.

outputs.name: video
outputs.description: The generated video, stored with the run and deleted with it (once the run's record goes); wire it through KeepFile to keep it past that.
